english.title: Postal service - obstruct person surveying land for postal service use
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed a person, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), who was authorised in writing by a universal service provider, from entering upon and surveying land, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), for the purpose of ascertaining whether it would be suitable for use in connection with the provision of a universal postal service
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 4(1) and (2) of Schedule 6 to the Postal Services Act 2000.
